title: Survival Node Gen 2 - Offline AI Emergency Preparedness Kit with Solar Battery, Faraday Bags and Weatherproof Case
description: The Survival Node Gen 2 is an off-grid emergency preparedness kit built around a hardened Motorola Moto G Power (2024) smartphone with 8GB RAM. It comes pre-loaded with 2 offline AI models, a pre-configured Survival Node AI agent, 50GB+ of survival apps, offline maps and directions for the entire United States, offline summaries of every Wikipedia article, medical and survival reference libraries, and a translation app. The AI, maps, and reference libraries run locally with no internet, cell signal, or power grid required. The kit includes a rugged 24,000 mAh solar battery with attached charging cables, two Mission Darkness Faraday bags (one for the phone, one for the battery), a shockproof phone case, wall charger and USB-C cable, and a weatherproof hard storage case with padlock. Ready to use out of the box. Ships free by ground to the 48 contiguous U.S. states.
